Results.Name: The two explicit HU tables yield current measurements, printed limits and fixed provenance
Decimal-comma, nonbreaking spaces and Unicode minus are normalized independently of locale
Each test mode and source system keeps its own slice rows
Reference values, scan parameters, multicolumn tables and other test sections are not current HU measurements
Missing or unsupported row structure is visible for review without inventing limits
Conflicting duplicate identity is omitted instead of selecting a convenient current value
Reversed printed bounds retain only the unambiguous value and require review
Mixed printed outcomes stay separate from numeric reading and cannot turn into clinical PASS
Incomplete and OCR-only input cannot claim a complete successful measurement read
Conflicting report dates flag the numeric evidence without accepting a clinical result
Unknown templates, extra sections and unbound text cannot supply measurements
Measurement count is bounded and clipping remains visible
Ambiguous thousands grouping and mismatched units are rejected
Wrapped numbered headings and split mode labels keep fixed document context

Scope: Synthetic IEC single-metric water/noise tables only. Explicit current HU values and printed bounds are kept separate from parenthesized references, scan parameters, other tables and clinical approval. Unknown, incomplete, conflicting, ambiguous and clipped evidence remains marked for review.
